ImmRequestMessageW - immdev/ImmRequestMessageW dev_langs: - c++ topic_type: - APIRef - kbSyntax api_type: - DllExport api_location: - Imm32.dll api_name: - ImmRequestMessage - ImmRequestMessageA - ImmRequestMessageW --- # ImmRequestMessageW function ## -description Generates a WM_IME_REQUEST message. ## -parameters ### -param HIMC [in] Handle to the target input context. ### -param WPARAM [in] Value of the wParam parameter for the WM_IME_REQUEST message. ### -param LPARAM [in] Value of the lParam parameter for the WM_IME_REQUEST message. ## -returns Returns an operation-specific value if successful, or 0 otherwise. ## -remarks IME must use this function instead of sending the WM_IME_REQUEST message to the application in a call to SendMessage. > [!NOTE] > The immdev.h header defines ImmRequestMessage as an alias that automatically selects the ANSI or Unicode version of this function based on the definition of the UNICODE preprocessor constant. Mixing usage of the encoding-neutral alias with code that is not encoding-neutral can lead to mismatches that result in compilation or runtime errors. For more information, see [Conventions for Function Prototypes](/windows/win32/intl/conventions-for-function-prototypes). ## -see-also Input Method Manager Input Method Manager Functions WM_IME_REQUEST
